meta.promptText: Which face wash should I buy for oily skin in India under ₹500?

response.text:
For **oily skin in India under ₹500**, I’d narrow it down to these:

### [Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Cleanser]()
*₹269*

### [Cetaphil Oily Skin Cleanser]()
*₹389*

### [The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide Anti-Acne Face Wash]()
*₹232*

### [Chemist At Play Oil & Acne Control Face Wash]()
*₹239*

### 🥇 My pick: Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Cleanser
**Around ₹269.** It’s my best choice if you have **oily skin + blackheads, clogged pores or occasional pimples**. Salicylic acid is oil-soluble and can help unclog pores; recent Indian recommendations also place this product among the strongest sub-₹500 options. [www.ndtvshopping.com](https://www.ndtvshopping.com/beauty-and-grooming/best-salicylic-acid-face-washes-for-acne-prone-skin-in-monsoon-11662605?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### If you don't have acne: Cetaphil Oily Skin Cleanser
**Around ₹389 for 59 ml.** Choose this if your main issue is **oiliness but your skin is sensitive or easily irritated**. It cleans excess sebum without aiming for an aggressive acne treatment. [www.gqindia.com](https://www.gqindia.com/content/5-best-face-washes-for-oily-skin-in-india?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### If you have frequent acne: The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide
**Around ₹232 currently.** It combines **2% salicylic acid + 2% niacinamide**, making it a good budget option for oily, acne-prone skin. [www.purplle.com](https://www.purplle.com/collections/salicylic-acid-face-wash-for-oily-skin?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Simple rule:**  
- 🛢️ Oily + clogged pores/acne → **Minimalist 2%**
- 🛢️ Oily + sensitive → **Cetaphil Oily Skin**
- 🛢️ Oily + frequent pimples → **Derma Co Sali-Cinamide**

If you tell me **your age and whether you have pimples/blackheads**, I can pick **one exact face wash** for you rather than giving you options.
